signature_features: yield line such as 6, 76% yield with bold number, comma and the word yield
new C-O bond and transferred D drawn in dark blue; the new C-Me bond from the methyl radical source is purple
substrates placed side by side with no plus sign
italic descriptor text under starting materials

notes.new_bond_color: Dark blue #024F8B is the darkest core of the new C-O bond in crop 02 and crop 03 (combined median; crop 02 alone #00508D, crop 03 alone #024F8A). Crop 01 has no formed bond and does not count. The new C-Me bond from the methyl radical source is purple (#58428A in crop 02, #584287 in crop 03); one new_bond_color cannot express it, so it is recorded here and in signature_features only.
notes.conditions_split: reagents_above_solvent_below. Crop 02: Ni(acac)2, KTp*, Ir (1) and BTTP above the arrow; t-AmOH, 450 nm LEDs and 4h below it. Crop 03: the catalyst icons above and only the 4 mmol scale below, which is not a solvent. Both reaction schemes split the conditions around the arrow. Crop 01 has no conditions. The drawing code keeps the brief's above and below lines as given.
notes.reagent_text_color: Not determined: crop 02 conditions text is black, crop 03 has the scale line below the arrow in blue (#024F8B). Only crop 02 carries black reagent text, so the crops disagree and the value is null.
notes.highlight_fill: Grey halo (#D5D5D5) behind the new bonds in crop 02 (scope rows and the top product) and crop 03 (product 5). The most common halo interior value is #D5D5D5 in crop 02 and in crop 03; antialiasing gives #D2D2D2 to #D7D7D7 at the edges.
notes.yield_placement: The compound number and yield share one line in crops 01 and 02 ('1, 61% yield', '(+/-)-6, 76% yield'), so after_product_label is kept and the README is corrected to match. Crop 03 gives the gram-scale yield in a rounded callout beside the product, which fits neither option.
notes.substrate_colors: Not applied: crop 02 colours the source labels (benzoyloxy source blue, methyl source purple), not the substrate structures, which are black.
notes.abbreviate_groups: Ar is drawn as a generic aryl in crops 02 and 03 but is not in the abbreviation table, so it is not applied.
notes.arrow_length_over_bond_length: Crop 02: arrow 105 px over a 20 px bond, 5.25 (card 5.2). Crop 03: arrow measures 132 px, but its bond length was not re-measured (the 20 px bond value is copied from crop 02), so its ratio is 6.6 only if that bond is also 20 px. Crop 01 has no arrow. Only crop 02 gives a verified ratio, so 5.2 is kept.
notes.measured_spread: Bond length over cap height: crop 01 2.30 (46/20), crop 02 2.22 (20/9), card 2.25. Line width over bond length: crop 01 0.054 (2.5/46), crop 02 0.060 (1.2/20), card 0.055. Crop 03 bond, cap and line values are copies of crop 02 and are excluded from the spread.
notes.bold_width_over_bond_length: no wedge large enough to measure

signature_features: catalyst icons (Ir, light bulb, Ni discs) above the arrow in the gram-scale scheme
reaction_scheme.notes: The icon feature rests on crop 03 alone. Crop 02 is a reaction scheme too but names the same catalysts in text (Ni(acac)2, KTp*, Ir (1), BTTP). The layout conventions for this type are the top-level conventions.

signature_features: substrate pairs joined by a light-blue curved double-headed arrow with no plus sign (crop 01 only)
racemic products marked (+/-) in the scope rows (crops 01, 02)
substrate_scope.notes: scope_layout grid: crop 01 has four substrate pairs per row and crop 02 has five products per row in its scope grid. The pair link arrow is drawn in crop 01 only.
